Rabbis sometimes saw time like 'an accordion that was expanded and collapsed at will.'[59] According to Kabbalists, 'time' is a paradox[60] and an illusion.[61] According to Advaita Vedanta, time is integral to the phenomenal world, which lacks independent reality.
